# Implement a ring buffer in C

Weekly build · 3 h · Status: done

Repository: https://github.com/octo-learner/ring-buffer

A fixed-capacity FIFO over a byte array, the kind every driver and audio path uses.

## Done when

- [ ] Push, pop, peek, full and empty handled without a wasted slot or with a documented one
- [ ] Tests, and a run under AddressSanitizer
